thread:
omar: Heads up — finance flagged a ~4% delta between the metering pipeline counts and the billing ledger for April 2. Looks concentrated on streaming tokens (long-lived connections).

claire: Ugh. Can you share invoice IDs or sample customer IDs so we can reconcile?

omar: Sent an example to you DM (cust_9921). Quick summary: pipeline tokens ~= 96k, ledger shows 100k.

jenna: Is this for streaming only or also for non-stream requests? Any pattern on retries?

omar: Mostly streaming sessions. Non-streaming requests line up. Retry rate is normal but I did notice a few requeues in the old SQS -> processor path.

metering-bot: ALERT: metering-pipeline::ack-latency-high — avg ack latency 12s, requeues 1.7k in last 6h. Trace id: trace-7f3b

sasha: Two quick suspects: 1) we historically drop suffix tokens when connection terminates mid-batch, 2) de-dup logic for reconnects might be overzealous for streaming. We added a safety dedupe in March but maybe it discards legitimate events.

ryan: Could any rollout changes to quotas/console be causing clients to reopen streams and trigger dedupe? We had a staged quota policy last week.

omar: Possibly. Customers that hit quota throttles often reconnect. If our dedupe key is session_id+nearest-minute it could collapse reconnects that should be separate.

claire: From billing perspective, missing tokens are bad even if they were under quota. We need exact counts for invoices. What short-term mitigations can we do?

jenna: We can enable per-message persistence for a subset of affected customers (debug mode) to stop relying on dedupe heuristics. Also enable extended trace sampling for the metering workers.

omar: I ran a quick BigQuery diff to local ledger table. Query I used:

```sql
SELECT event_type, SUM(tokens) as tokens 
FROM `redwood-prod.metering.events` 
WHERE ingestion_date = '2025-04-02' AND customer_id = 'cust_9921'
GROUP BY event_type;
```

Result: streaming=95984, api_request=4021. Ledger shows streaming=100102.

sasha: That's a big gap. Can you paste a snippet of raw worker logs around one reconnection? Looking for ack vs commit ordering.

omar: Here is condensed log (sanitized):

```
[2025-04-02T18:12:01Z] worker-7 INFO received batch id=bb1 size=512 tokens=4892
[2025-04-02T18:12:02Z] worker-7 INFO persisted offset=1245 commit_id=c-9
[2025-04-02T18:12:03Z] worker-7 WARN connection lost session=ss-44
[2025-04-02T18:12:06Z] worker-7 INFO requeued batch id=bb1 reason=conn-reopen
[2025-04-02T18:12:07Z] worker-8 INFO dedupe dropped batch id=bb1 key=ss-44:2025-04-02T18:12:0X
```

jenna: That requeue+dropped pattern would cause tokens to be omitted if dedupe drops the retried batch before ledger write completes.

ryan: We should decide whether billing should be driven by the authoritative ledger (persisted commits) or by the ingestion stream. For customer-facing invoices ledger must win. But product needs near-real-time dashboard counts — that's the UX tradeoff.

claire: Agreed. For invoices ledger first. Dashboard can show provisional counts with a badge explaining finality. Customers will complain but it's better than wrong invoices.

omar: Proposal: 1) short term: flip dedupe to keep requeued batches until commit ack from ledger; 2) enable debug persistence for affected customers; 3) add a reconciliation job that replays uncommitted requeues and produces a delta report per invoice.

sasha: I can push a patch to the dedupe TTL/semantics today — change key to include processing-seq and accept duplicates until commit. Need an RFC?

jenna: Also add trace id propagation into the ledger write so reconciliation can map ingestion events to ledger rows.

metering-bot: NOTE: metering-dashboard::jobs — reconciliation job currently runs nightly at 03:00 UTC. Last run had 0 anomalies flagged.

omar: We should run the reconciliation job retroactively for 2025-04-01..2025-04-03 and produce a per-customer delta file for finance.

claire: Please cc billing ops. If we've undercounted by 4% we need to assess revenue impact and whether to adjust invoices or credit next cycle.

ryan: UX follow-up: Console should show a new "finalized" timestamp on usage charts and a tooltip about provisional numbers. I'll draft a small rollout plan so we don't confuse users.

omar: Action items: sasha to change dedupe semantics (P0 patch), jenna to add trace propagation to ledger write, ops to run replay for 4/1-4/3, finance to reconcile and decide invoice action. I'll open tickets and tag billing-ops.

sasha: On it, will submit PR and link to this thread.

jenna: I'll add the trace id field to the write and bump sampling rate for debug customers.

claire: Thanks everyone. Please include cost estimate for the replay run (I know large replays can hit infra).

omar: Will include estimate in the ticket.

ryan: I'll schedule a short console UX sync after we have the reconciliation numbers.

omar: Thanks — keeping this thread for visibility. :thumbsup:
